title: Pura Compra - E-commerce Intermediary
description: A platform connecting users with multiple online stores, providing a unified shopping experience with intelligent price comparisons and streamlined checkout process.
production_description: This platform was designed and deployed for real-world use, enabling users to purchase products in an automated and efficient manner. The system integrates modern technologies to deliver a complete e-commerce experience.

production_features.title: Payment System
production_features.description: Full integration with secure payment gateways

production_features.title: Admin Dashboard
production_features.description: Specialized views for managing products, orders, and users

production_features.title: Address Manager
production_features.description: Complete system for managing multiple shipping addresses

production_features.title: Color Selector
production_features.description: Visualization and selection of product variants by color

production_features.title: Web Scraping
production_features.description: Automatic extraction of information from selected stores

production_features.title: Automated Quotes
production_features.description: Automatic generation and sending of quotes to the store owner

overview_p1: Pura Compra is an e-commerce intermediary platform that simplifies online shopping by aggregating products from multiple stores into a single, unified interface. Users can compare prices, read reviews, and complete purchases without navigating between different websites.
overview_p2: The platform integrates with various online retailers, normalizes product data, and provides intelligent recommendations based on price, availability, and shipping options.
overview_p3: Built as a university project, it demonstrates proficiency in full-stack development, API integration, and creating user-centric e-commerce solutions.

challenges.title: Store Integration
challenges.description: Developed a flexible integration layer that connects with multiple online stores while handling different data formats and APIs.

challenges.title: Price Comparison
challenges.description: Implemented real-time price comparison algorithms that account for shipping, taxes, and promotional offers.

challenges.title: Unified Experience
challenges.description: Created a seamless shopping experience that abstracts away the complexity of purchasing from multiple stores.
